title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalam O Alaikum, This is regarding Fatwa ID No. 14851. Alhamdulillah you have already replied my earlier questions. But people are not satisfied with this reply they say you have not asked the question clearly. Now I would like to tell you the incident in detail, what was happened in our Masjid. "One day Imam lead salah from the first row, after the salah one of the muqtadi who is also a knowledgable person objurgate Imam for this act (To lead salah from the first row). He told Imam that this is undesirable (Mukrooh) to lead salah from the first row without having any proper reason. He further said I have already asked you to stop this act then what is the proble with you? Kindly send an early reply. Allah Hafiz 3046 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 156779 Country: India Title: Having problem in offering salah during job Question: If I get a job/work with good amount of income, securing/ offering salat/namaz/prayer properly on time couldn't be guaranteed. Whereas, if I work for a very low amount, offering salah/namaz/prayer on time is a possibility (seems easy). Problem: my parents (who are not Muslims) need certain amount of money to meet their home's financial needs. They have already lost their wealth etc. after my acceptance of Islam because of all my mistake. In-shaAllah, this could be taken care but offering salah/namaz/prayer properly on time becomes doubtful then (specially on regular basis). I am worried about my Huquq-e-Ibad that Allah Rabbul Alameen would not forgive me! Please guide. Answer ID: 156779 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 316/254/N=3/1439) Salah is one of the important duties of Islam. It is unlawful and major sin to miss salah intentionally or without a Shariah excuse. (Fatawa Mahmoodia Jadid, Dhabel, 7, 388, Question: 3475). Thus you should adopt such employment where you can offer salah with jamat in time though you receive low salary, you shall have barakat in the salary in-shaAllah and all your expenses will be fulfilled and thus you would be able to serve your parents financially. التأخير بلا عذر كبيرة لا تزول بالقضاء بل بالتوبة أو الحج ، ومن العذر العدو وخوف القابلة موت الولد؛ لأنه عليه السلام أخرها يوم الخندق (الدر المختار مع رد المحتار، كتاب الصلاة، باب قضاء الفوائت، 2: 518، 519، ط: مكتبة زكريا ديوبند)، قوله: "ومن العذر" : أي: لجواز تأخير الوقتية الخ ، قوله: "العدو": ....... هذا حيث لم يمكنه فعلها أصلا (رد المحتار). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
